turns.prompt:
Combine exports/shipments-*.csv. The files have the same header and distinct shipment IDs. Sum units per sku using only rows with state=shipped. Create summary.csv with header sku,units, one row for each SKU that has shipped rows, sorted by sku in ASCII order. Do not include pending or cancelled units or a total row.
Work in /app. Process the inputs in bulk and actually create the requested files. Keep every original input file unchanged. Bash, python3 and basic system commands are available; no network or package installation is needed.
